noFileInScope: No file left in scope "{scope}" after exclusions.
filesLine: {files} files, {excluded} excluded by the profile, {batches} batches:
guardArmed: Guard armed: excluded files are unreadable, writes are limited to the run and the reports.
consolidated: {findings} unique findings, {rejected} rejected by the schema.
profileChanged: ⚠ The profile changed since the previous scan: part of the difference may come from it.
partialScope: Partial scope: no "resolved" list, no history entry.
consistent: Profiles and config are consistent with the repository.
unsupportedLanguage: ✗ language "{value}" is not supported ({list}): English is used
noBuiltinNoOverlay: {type}: no built-in profile and no overlay
excludedRead: {rel} is excluded by the "{type}" profile ({glob}). Do not read it: the exclusion list is part of the profile.
scanWrite: Scan in progress ({run}): writes are limited to {allowed}. {rel} is not one of them — a scan reports, it does not fix.
scanCommand: Scan in progress ({run}): command that would modify the repository denied ({pattern}). Reading, counting and running tests is fine; writing is not. Write findings with the Write tool into the run directory.
remWrite: Remediation of {finding}: {target} is out of bounds ({glob}). Stop and report it instead of changing it.
remCommand: Remediation of {finding}: command denied by the config ({source}).
remProtected: Remediation of {finding}: the current branch "{branch}" is protected. Create the fix branch first.
remPush: Remediation of {finding}: push to a protected branch.
forbiddenTrailer: The last commit carries a forbidden attribution ({list}). Remove it with git commit --amend before going on.
unsupportedReportFormat: ✗ report format "{value}" is not supported ({list}): html is used
mode_fix: fixes on a new branch, no report
mode_review: report, then your choice of findings, then fixes on a new branch
unsupportedMode: ✗ scan mode "{value}" is not supported ({list}): report is used
badSelection: Unknown selection "{token}": use F<n>, a severity, >=<severity> (or <severity>+), all or none.
selectionEmpty: No finding selected in {run}: nothing to fix.
worktreeExists: A worktree already exists at {worktree}: remove it (git worktree remove) or finish that fix first.
worktreeFailed: Could not create the fix worktree: {error}
fixReady: Fix branch {branch} created from {base}; {n} finding(s) to fix, one commit each, one after the other. Remediation guard armed.
fixSummary: {fixed} fixed, {skipped} not fixed, {failed} failed, {pending} not reached — {commits} commit(s) on {branch} (base {base}). Worktree: {worktree}
unsupportedAgentSetting: ✗ {type}: {setting} "{value}" is not supported ({list}): inherit is used
agentsChoices: Models: {models}. Efforts: {efforts}. inherit: the session's own.
repoNoGit: git is not installed, or not on the PATH: this command needs it.
repoNone: {dir} is not a git repository, and this command needs one. `repo plan` shows what a first commit would hold; `repo init --commit` creates the repository.
repoEmpty: {dir} is a git repository without any commit, and this command needs one. `repo init --commit` commits the current files.
repoAlready: {dir} is already a git repository with commits.
repoPlanFiles: A first commit would hold {n} file(s) — the .gitignore applies.
repoPlanFlagged: Worth a look before committing (secrets, keys, dependencies, build output, large files):
repoPlanClean: Nothing looks like a secret, a key, a dependency or a build output.
repoNothingToCommit: Nothing to commit: the folder is empty, or everything is ignored.
